scientific_integrity: Classical Gaussian and Jacobi quadrature are credited. Universal proof is analytic; finite computations corroborate but do not replace it.
scientific_limitations: Exact degree-ell harmonic band only; not a full multi-degree band.
Minimality concerns number of distinct absolute latitudes, not all sample points.
For a concrete finite tight frame the longitude nodes are equally spaced with at least 2ell+1 samples per ring.
Radial minimal designs are classified for strictly interior squared-latitude nodes with positive ring weights.
Historical novelty remains provisional; an equivalent older cubature formulation may exist.
title: Sharp hemispheric latitude-ring sampling for a single spherical-harmonic degree
